rows.question: How do I control grass weeds in a paddy nursery?
rows.query_en: How do I control grass weeds in a paddy nursery?
rows.answer: Control grass weeds in a paddy nursery by applying any of the pre-emergence herbicides such as Pyrazosulfuron ethyl @ 20 g/ha on 3rd or 4th day after sowing to control weeds in the lowland nursery. Alternatively, use pre-emergence herbicides like Butachlor 1.0 l/ha or Pendimethalin 1.0 l/ha, applying them on 8 DAS with thin layer of water in the field.

rows.query_en: How to control weeds in a paddy nursery
rows.answer: Weeds in a paddy nursery can be controlled by applying pre-emergence herbicides such as Pyrazosulfuron ethyl or Butachlor, or Pendimethalin, on 3rd or 4th day after sowing, depending on the height of the seedlings. Additionally, a thin film of water should be kept on the soil to control germinating weeds. [4]

rows.question: Should I spray synthetic pyrethroids on cotton early in the season?
rows.query_en: Should I spray synthetic pyrethroids on cotton early in the season?
rows.answer: No, synthetic pyrethroids should not be used on cotton early in the season, as they can cause problems with whiteflies. The use of synthetic pyrethroids should be discouraged in cotton to avoid the problem of whitefly resurgence. Instead, biological control methods should be adopted on a community basis in specified cotton areas.

rows.question: How can I reduce pink bollworm carry-over in cotton?
rows.query_en: How can I reduce pink bollworm carry-over in cotton?
rows.answer: To reduce pink bollworm carry-over in cotton, use Sticka/Delta traps with at least 10 micro litre of gossyplure and place them at 15 cm above the crop canopy. Replace the lure after 15 days and use 1 trap per ha. Additionally, apply mating disruption based management using gossyplure 4% (7, 11 Hexadecadienyl acetate) after the last picking, allowing farm animals to feed on plant debris and un-opened bolls.

Replace the lure after 15 days and use 1 trap per ha. Additionally, apply mating disruption based management using gossyplure 4% (7, 11 Hexadecadienyl acetate) after the last picking, allowing farm animals to feed on plant debris and un-opened bolls. rows.question: कपास में गुलाबी सुंडी को अगले मौसम तक पहुँचने से कैसे रोकें?
rows.query_en: How to prevent the pink sundae in cotton from reaching the next season?
rows.answer: गुलाबी बोलवर्म लार्वा को बुवाई से पहले बीज को एसिड - डिलिटिंग करके मारा जा सकता है जैसा कि उल्लेख किया गया है । इसके अतिरिक्त किसानों को बिना धुएं वाले बीज को नहीं रखना चाहिए या बेचना चाहिए और इसके बजाय मार्च के अंत तक बीज को पीसना चाहिए और इसे मवेशियों को खिलाना चाहिए ताकि लार्वा को जीवित रहने से रोका जा सके ।
rows.answer_en: The pink bollworm larvae can be killed by acid-delinting the seed before sowing, as mentioned in [3]. Additionally, farmers should not retain or sell un-fumigated seed, and instead ginning the seed by the end of March and feeding it to cattle to prevent the larvae from surviving, as stated in [3].

rows.question: పత్తిలో గులాబీ రంగు కాయ తొలుచు పురుగు తర్వాతి సీజన్‌కు రాకుండా ఎలా ఆపాలి?
rows.query_en: How to stop the pink leaf borer in cotton from coming in the next season?
rows.answer: To prevent the pink bollworm (PBW) from coming in the next season, after the final picking, PBW infested cotton fields should be shredded with the help of a shredder to kill the larvae [3]. Additionally, all trash collected during the ginning process should be destroyed, and all seed left uncrushed in the mills should be fumigated with Celphos/Phostoxin/Delicia @ one 3-g tablet per cubic metre space, giving an exposure of 48 hours or use two tablets with an exposure of 24 hours [3].
rows.answer_en: To prevent the pink bollworm (PBW) from coming in the next season, after the final picking, PBW infested cotton fields should be shredded with the help of a shredder to kill the larvae [3].
